tests.name: AC1: SKILL documents apply aliases
AC1: SKILL documents verify aliases
AC1: SKILL names Phase 2 as wiki-vs-code statement verify

acceptanceCriteria.text: `ws-wiki/SKILL.md` names Phase 1 as sweep/backfill, Phase 2 as wiki-vs-code statement verify, and Phase 3 as findings plan plus batch apply, and documents `/ws-wiki verify` (aliases `audit`, `check-code`) and `/ws-wiki apply` (aliases `reconcile`, `phase-3`).

tests.name: AC2: SKILL documents post-sweep Phase 2 offer

acceptanceCriteria.text: After a successful Phase 1 sweep finish (including empty-queue success), the agent presents a `user-gate` before ending the turn with recommended option Run Phase 2 wiki-vs-code audit versus Skip. Skip writes no verify artifacts. Cancel STOP. `autoMode` takes the recommended option without prompting.

tests.name: NS1: SKILL documents missing-index STOP

acceptanceCriteria.text: `/ws-wiki verify` without `index.wiki.md` STOP with a message to run `/ws-wiki init` first; it does not invent an index or feature pages.

tests.name: AC4: SKILL documents verify enumerator usage
verify enumerator returns pages array

acceptanceCriteria.text: Helper `.agents/skills/ws-wiki/scripts/list_wiki_feature_pages.cjs` lists repo-relative POSIX paths of `{wikiDir}/**/*.md` excluding `index.wiki.md` and any `*.state.json`; `--json` prints `{ ok, pages: [{ file, domain, feature }], errors }`. Sort is POSIX path lexicographic.

tests.name: AC5: --specs-dir rejected as unknown with exit 2
NS3: unknown flag exits 2

acceptanceCriteria.text: Helper CLI validates `--repo-root` / `--wiki-dir` with directory containment (resolved path stays under repo root); unknown flags and leftover argv tokens are rejected before `readdir`; `--help` exits 0 and is never a filename.

tests.name: AC6: SKILL documents sequential walk in helper order
pages sorted POSIX lexicographic

acceptanceCriteria.text: Phase 2 walks pages in helper order, one page at a time (no parallel writes to the same wiki file). For each page it extracts checkable statements from Business Rules & Logic and Technical Architecture as specified in Description; Feature Overview only when the claim is a testable invariant.

tests.name: AC7: SKILL documents four-class classification
AC7: SKILL requires evidence pointer per statement

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each extracted statement is classified `confirmed` | `differs` | `absent` | `inconclusive` with at least one evidence pointer (file path + line or explicit `no match`). Classifications are written to checkpoint before the next page.

tests.name: AC8: SKILL documents --dry-run purity (no verify.state.json or specs)
NS4: page mtime unchanged after queue listing

acceptanceCriteria.text: During the Phase 2 walk the agent does not present the findings apply plan, does not apply wiki edits, does not run `ws-spec-write`, and does not mutate product source. `--dry-run` on verify prints the page queue (and checkpoint summary if present) and writes neither wiki pages, nor `verify.state.json`, nor specs.

tests.name: AC9: SKILL documents audited finish
AC9: SKILL documents zero-actionable skips Phase 3 gate

acceptanceCriteria.text: After the last Phase 2 page, checkpoint `status` is `audited`. Actionable findings trigger a `user-gate` (recommended Run Phase 3 versus Skip). Skip writes no wiki or spec updates. Cancel STOP. Zero actionable findings skips the gate. `autoMode` takes recommended when the gate is shown.

tests.name: AC10: SKILL documents findings plan rows

acceptanceCriteria.text: Phase 3 starts by presenting a findings plan listing every `differs` and `absent` row (wiki path, quoted statement, evidence, proposed wiki edit vs proposed code-change spec). `confirmed` / `inconclusive` counts appear in the summary only.

tests.name: AC11: SKILL documents truth-gate Update wiki recommended

acceptanceCriteria.text: For each actionable finding Phase 3 presents a `user-gate` with recommended option Update wiki (code/absence is truth) and option Update code (wiki statement is truth). Host structured choice when `askQuestionTool` is bound; markdown fallback yields the turn. Cancel STOP without applying the un-decided remainder.

tests.name: AC12: SKILL documents wiki batch apply

acceptanceCriteria.text: After Phase 3 decisions are recorded, wiki-directed findings are applied in one batch (in-place 3-section pages, no changelog append). Then `sync_wiki_index.cjs` if catalog lines changed, then `validate_wiki.cjs --check`. Product `.cjs`/skill bodies outside `{wikiDir}` are not edited for those findings.

tests.name: AC13: SKILL carries exact code-directed spec template
AC13: SKILL pins source local for code-directed specs

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each code-directed finding produces a standalone `ws-spec-write` (skill `ws-spec-write`, not a `{plansDir}` register) whose description is exactly the template `Update feature {title} to reflect current wiki statement: {statement}` with `{title}` from the wiki page title or index one-liner and `{statement}` the quoted wiki text. Frontmatter `source: local`. Phase 3 does not implement those specs and does not start an orchestrator.

tests.name: AC14: SKILL documents checkpoint schema
AC14: SKILL forbids staging checkpoint in product commits

acceptanceCriteria.text: Checkpoint `{wikiDir}/verify.state.json` records `status` (`running` | `audited` | `applying` | `completed`), `completedPages`, `lastFile`, `findings` (id, page, statement, class, evidence, decision), `startedAt`, and `updatedAt`. Agents must not stage this file in product commits.

tests.name: AC15: SKILL documents --resume continues after lastFile
AC15: SKILL documents apply-without-audit STOP

acceptanceCriteria.text: `--resume` on verify continues after `lastFile` unless `--force`. `/ws-wiki apply` without `status: audited` (or leftover pending decisions) STOP. Successful Phase 3 apply sets `status: completed` or deletes the file.

tests.name: AC16: empty feature set returns findings 0 shape

acceptanceCriteria.text: Empty feature-page wiki (index only) is Phase 2 success: findings `0`, no Phase 3 gate, validate still run if index exists.

tests.name: list_wiki_feature_pages exits 0 on populated wiki

acceptanceCriteria.text: `test/test-wiki.js` (or a sibling `test/test-wiki-verify.js` listed in `package.json` test scripts) covers AC4–AC5, AC8 dry-run, AC15 resume skip and apply-without-audit STOP, empty pages, containment/unknown-flag failures, and SKILL/CATALOG strings for Phase 2 `/ws-wiki verify` and Phase 3 `/ws-wiki apply`.

tests.name: AC18: CATALOG mentions Phase 2 wiki-vs-code verify

acceptanceCriteria.text: `CATALOG.md` task-router / skill row mentions Phase 2 wiki-vs-code verify and Phase 3 plan/apply. No host/IDE product names in skill body, gates, or scripts (portable `user-gate` / `askQuestion` alias only).

tests.name: live hardening spec must pass authoring validation

acceptanceCriteria.text: Authoring validation for this specification exits 0.

tests.name: NS1: SKILL documents missing-index STOP

negativeScenarios.text: Missing `index.wiki.md`: `/ws-wiki verify` STOP; helper may still fail or list nothing; skill must not write feature pages.

tests.name: NS2: --wiki-dir outside repo root fails closed

negativeScenarios.text: `--wiki-dir` resolving outside repo root: helper exit non-zero, no `readdir` of the escaped path.

tests.name: NS3: unknown flag exits 2

negativeScenarios.text: Unknown argv token / leftover `--help` as path: `--help` exit 0; other dash tokens non-zero (no `ENOENT` on `--help`).

tests.name: NS4: page mtime unchanged after queue listing

negativeScenarios.text: `--dry-run` after a partial checkpoint: no wiki file mtime/content change, no new checkpoint write, no new spec files.

tests.name: NS5: SKILL documents post-sweep Skip writes nothing

negativeScenarios.text: Post-sweep Phase 2 Skip: no `verify.state.json` and no spec-write from that turn.

tests.name: NS6: SKILL documents post-verify Skip writes nothing

negativeScenarios.text: Post-Phase-2 Phase 3 Skip: checkpoint stays `audited`; no wiki edits and no spec-write until `/ws-wiki apply`.

tests.name: AC15: SKILL documents apply-without-audit STOP

negativeScenarios.text: `/ws-wiki apply` with no audited checkpoint: STOP; no wiki or spec writes.

tests.name: NS8: SKILL documents pending on truth-gate Cancel

negativeScenarios.text: Truth-gate Cancel after some decisions: wiki batch applies only decided wiki items or applies none until a later `--resume` apply step; undecided findings stay `pending`; no product code edits.

tests.name: NS9: SKILL documents assertContained no-escape writers

negativeScenarios.text: Path-traversal domain/feature from a malicious wiki filename: writers reject; no write outside `{wikiDir}`.

tests.name: NS10: verify helper performs no network fetch

negativeScenarios.text: Unauthenticated network calls: N/A because verify does not call SCM HTTP; a regression that adds unauthenticated remote fetch for verify is a failing case (must not ship).

tests.name: AC5: --specs-dir rejected as unknown with exit 2

negativeScenarios.text: Stack path-containment / unknown-flag failures on the new helper (same class as sweep enumerator).
